topic: Pick a restaurant for Friday dinner

scenario.topic: Pick a restaurant for Friday dinner
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to you for Friday dinner—ambiance, cost, travel time, or menu variety?

options.name: The Green Olive Mediterranean Bistro

attrs.menu_variety: Mediterranean with vegetarian and gluten-free options

options.upside: Offers a cozy atmosphere with healthy, diverse dishes including many dietary accommodations.
options.tradeoff: Slightly pricier than some options and a bit of a longer drive.
options.concern: Moderate noise level might make conversation a little harder during busy hours.
options.best_for: Those prioritizing food quality and dietary variety over cost or travel time.

options.name: Frank’s BBQ Smokehouse
options.upside: Close walking distance and affordable prices with hearty, flavorful meals.
options.tradeoff: Loud environment and limited menu options for non-meat eaters.
options.concern: Noise level might make it tough to have a quiet conversation.
options.best_for: Those valuing convenience and cost savings over quiet or menu variety.

options.name: Luna’s Italian Trattoria

attrs.menu_variety: Classic Italian with extensive pasta and seafood options

options.upside: Quiet, intimate setting with a rich menu perfect for a relaxed dinner.
options.tradeoff: Highest cost and longest travel time among options.
options.concern: Public transit may add complexity to getting there and back.
options.best_for: Those prioritizing ambiance and a quiet environment over cost and travel time.

options.name: Saffron Street Indian Cuisine

attrs.menu_variety: Wide range of spicy and mild Indian dishes, many vegetarian options

options.upside: Good balance of cost, travel time, and flavorful, diverse menu options.
options.tradeoff: Moderate noise and some dishes may be too spicy for sensitive palates.
options.concern: Not all group members enjoy spicy food, which could limit choices.
options.best_for: Those looking for flavorful variety without breaking the budget or traveling far.

shared_context: The group consists of exactly 3 friends planning dinner together on Friday evening.
Each person prefers to keep the total cost per person under $40.
They want a place that can accommodate a casual conversation without too much noise.

personas.name: Faye
personas.background: Faye recently started a vegetarian diet for health reasons and wants to maintain variety without sacrificing taste.
personas.private_goal: To enjoy a healthy, diverse meal with good vegetarian options in a cozy atmosphere.

personas.name: Oscar
personas.background: Oscar has a demanding job and values a quiet, relaxing environment to unwind and have meaningful conversations.
personas.private_goal: To have a calm, intimate dinner experience with high-quality food, even if it costs more or takes longer to get there.

personas.name: Amir
personas.background: Amir recently moved closer to the meeting point and prefers places within walking distance to avoid driving.
personas.private_goal: To pick an affordable, convenient restaurant that is easy to get to and suits a social, lively atmosphere.
